newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.85 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index rises 0.85 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index added 0.70 points, or 0.85 percent, to 83.38 on Friday,after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index provisionally rose 0.04 percent to 3,733.42.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market rose to 17.60 percent from 16.64 percent on Thursday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
